name: pmp-paints-erp-workspace
description: PMP PAINTS Enterprise Cloud ERP — Unified Web & Windows Desktop Orchestrator

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix web --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix desktop --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.test:desktop: node desktop/scripts/ensure-desktop-assets.mjs && node desktop/scripts/sync-renderer.mjs && npm test --prefix desktop
scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process');if(!fs.existsSync('web/node_modules'))cp.execSync('npm ci --prefix web --no-audit --no-fund',{stdio:'inherit'});" && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.desktop:dist:win: node desktop/scripts/sync-renderer.mjs && npm run dist:win --prefix desktop
